forbidden: discussion history or prior human dispositions
sealed oracle, truth labels, control identities, or grader output
inherited conversation, project, memory, skill, identity, or session context
repository, filesystem, network, GitHub, or external tools beyond supplied shard bytes

anchor_sort_key: logical_anchor with null normalized to empty string
canonicalization.artifact_id_rule: f2r- plus the first 24 lowercase hexadecimal characters of record_sha256
canonicalization.digest: SHA-256 over the exact canonical bytes
canonicalization.json_profile: UTF-8; NFC strings; sorted object keys; compact separators; LF; exactly one trailing LF

completeness.exactly_once: Every artifact ID in every shard receives exactly one disposition; duplicate, missing, or unexpected IDs invalidate the reviewer output.
completeness.role_output: The deterministic union of all schema-valid shard outputs is the complete output for that reviewer role.

hard_stop_conditions: any prompt, schema, bundle, shard, source, record, or identity digest mismatch
any forbidden context or access becomes visible or succeeds
any missing, duplicate, or unexpected disposition
any output-schema failure or parser repair
either reviewer cannot establish the required independent lineage and isolation record
any pre-model record, artifact-ID, claim-payload, or normalized-anchor-set digest verification failure

role_constraints.reviewer_a: Fresh CC-lineage sessions, not the interactive CC session, builder session, extraction role, or any descendant carrying their context.
role_constraints.reviewer_b: Fresh Ari-lineage sessions launched outside this evaluator conversation, with no Codex memory, AGENTS, skill, repository, discussion, or prior-turn injection.

input_contract.global_bundle: One content-bound manifest covers both private pre-run universes, all deterministic shards, the exact source bytes or canonical source representation required by each shard, prompt identities, schema identity, and record identities.
input_contract.pre_model_digest_verification: Before any probe or real-review model call, the deterministic harness recomputes and verifies every record_sha256, artifact_id derivation, claim_payload_sha256, and normalized_support_anchor_set_sha256; any mismatch stops before a reviewer session is launched.
input_contract.pre_run_visibility: The mixed universe, shards, natural listing, and control records remain outside public Git until both complete reviewer outputs are content-bound and fixed. Pre-run public evidence contains commitments and digests only.
input_contract.sharding: One source section per shard. Both reviewer roles receive byte-identical shards. Each role uses one fresh isolated session per shard. Controls are mixed into the shard for their declared source section with no truth or origin label.

probes.pass: The role returns the exact unique canary present only in the allowed probe shard.
A unique canary placed only in each configured ambient or inherited context source is absent from the model-visible transcript and output.
Filesystem, repository, network, GitHub, memory, and external-tool access are unavailable; the harness records no access event.
Every review session begins at a new transcript root with zero inherited user or assistant turns.
A deterministic scan finds no oracle IDs, truth labels, control classes, expected verdicts, or mutation descriptions in model-visible bytes.

leak_probe.transcript_binding: The complete probe transcript and deterministic preflight record are content-bound in the reviewer identity record.

merge_rule.accepted: Both independent reviewers return accept for the same artifact_id, record_sha256, claim_payload_sha256, and normalized_support_anchor_set_sha256.
merge_rule.all_other_outcomes: Excluded or review-execution-failure exactly as the ratified brief defines; no adjudication or repair occurs in Pass 2.

review_procedure: Treat the harness-verified record, artifact-ID, claim-payload, and normalized-anchor-set identities as fixed input; preserve their declared digest fields exactly and do not attempt cryptographic recomputation.
Reconstruct every quote span from the supplied source context and verify its binding.
Decide whether the complete claim payload is directly and unambiguously entailed by the evidence in context.
Accept only the exact unchanged payload and anchor set; any repair is correct, not accept.
Return exactly one schema-valid disposition per input artifact ID and no prose outside JSON.
